# Folder Description
This is the folder for Phase 1 of the project: Descriptive Analysis. 
The folder contains the results of the descriptive analysis of HFMD in City XX, including descriptions of its temporal, geographic, and population distribution. 
The temporal distribution analysis covers short-term fluctuations, periodicity, seasonality, and long-term trends.
# Contents of the folder
* Code files in the Notebooks format used for data analysis.
* The output files generated by the data analysis are saved in .csv format.
